title_sq: APARTAMENT 3+1+2 PER SHITJE TE TOUCH OF SUN
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Saukut te Rezidenca Touch of Sun ofrohet apartament 3+1+2 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje rezidence te re me ashensor te mireadministruar.
Sip. totale e apartamentit eshte 145.71 m2 dhe organizohet ne korridor, tre dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, dy tualete, ballkon.
Prona eshte e investuar me detaje dhe shitet e mobiluar.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion ose shoqerim ne prone lutemi te na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT 3+1+2 FOR SALE TOUCH OF SUN
description_en: A 3+1+2 apartment is offered for sale in the area of ​​Sauk at Touch of Sun Residence. The apartment is located on the second floor of a new residence with a well-managed elevator. Sip. the total area of ​​the apartment is 145.71 m2 and is organized in a corridor, three bedrooms, living room with kitchen area, two toilets, balcony.
